notes: Found an Instacart bouquet under budget, took one approval through a connected payment account, and confirmed the order in 24 minutes.
Took a flowers order from prompt to confirmed delivery, though it asked four setup questions first despite a no-questions brief.
Three nonstop options with fare classes and a recommendation in five minutes, then the payment handoff failed at booking.
Asked unprompted whether the user would be in New York for the dinner, given the Chicago trip it had just priced.
Named the right vegan spots instantly, but the flowers search needed two pushes before it stopped asking about preferences.
Sent four unprompted delivery updates down to the driver arriving, drawing on context it learned from the user's photo library.
Asks before paying and before booking, but front-loaded delivery and preference questions on a request that asked for none.
Connects Apple and Google Calendar, Apple passes, contacts and a payment account, plus an MCP, but no Slack, Notion or Gmail send.
Cannot send from Gmail; it drafts the message and opens it in the device's Mail app for the user to send.
